alert: SpendWise AI Parse Failure Rate High
summary: AI parse failures above 10% in local
description: 28.81% of AI transaction parsing requests in the local environment failed over the last 5 minutes (threshold 10%). Users asking for an AI draft are likely getting errors; entering a transaction by hand still works.
runbook: Open the SpendWise dashboard's AI transaction parsing row: provider errors point to the AI provider being unavailable, validation errors to answers that could not be used. Then the API's logs in Loki for this environment.
